profile.overview: Golgari Swarm is the black-green Ravnican guild whose source-bounded identity joins life, death, decay, reanimation, survival, underground society, and food production.
profile.philosophy: Golgari treats death and decay as useful material inside a living cycle, not as generic morbidity or generic nature.
profile.core_tension: Golgari is strongest when reclamation feeds survival and renewal; it weakens when reduced to black-green color identity, graveyard aesthetics, or fatalistic rot without a cycle.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guide presents Golgari as an underground society in forgotten places that also feeds much of Ravnica.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Undergrowth expresses Golgari by turning creatures in graveyards into present power.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.

limitations: Gate 3 uses existing official Golgari overview, mechanics, and prerelease source records for authoritative semantic proof.
MTG-Stories repository rows are retained as discovery metadata only until a later deep story localization pass supplies bounded source locations.
Placement language is Vox Mana interpretation and must not be presented as official Wizards personality canon.

core_identity.summary: Golgari Swarm is the black-green guild whose authoritative signal is death-to-life reclamation, decay, undercity survival, food production, and graveyard resource use.
core_identity.philosophy: Death and decay matter because they become material for survival, food, and renewal.
core_identity.central_tension: The Swarm can make loss useful, but it becomes a false positive when only generic resilience, nature, morbidity, or black-green color identity is present.

site_surface.tagline: What is discarded can feed the next cycle.

structure.summary: The official guide presents Golgari as an underground society in forgotten and unwanted places, with a farming role that feeds much of Ravnica.

great_tension.summary: Golgari placement must preserve the source-backed cycle of death, decay, underground survival, food production, and renewal while suppressing generic BG resilience or rot aesthetics.
great_tension.placement_relevance: Used to distinguish Golgari from generic black-green, Witherbloom, Selesnya, Abzan, Jund, Sultai, and other adjacent readings.
